design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (residential_gas_care). Round 1 authored from Step 0; round 2 revisions recorded at the end.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 4, 5]}. Assignment: gas_ext_renewal_rate 6, gas_ext_latest_bill_rebill_credit 4, gas_ext_signup_credit 4, gas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit 5. Tree: root renewal acceptance (owner=user) fanning out to three agent prerequisites; 3 value_input edges (floor max(3-1,1)=2).

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: gas_ext_recontract_rate / accept_gas_recontract_offer_a9611340 and gas_ext_added_premise_rate / enroll_gas_added_premise_5ded636b. Claimed here: gas_ext_renewal_rate / accept_gas_renewal_offer_6e431548 (in-term election), gas_ext_latest_bill_rebill_credit / post_gas_rebill_credit_0e7c2434, gas_ext_signup_credit / post_gas_signup_credit_32aac0cb, gas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit / post_gas_loyalty_credit_c1183f95. All six policies claimed, pairwise disjoint.

[Why a good test] Surface goal: 'accept the renewal offer'. The renewal rule carries three prerequisite sentences; find_gas_billing shows (a) the latest energy line, cycle 2026-09-04, billed at the 0.8450 ceiling while the timely variable notice in force (issued 2026-08-17, effective 2026-09-01) says 0.6620 and no rebill credit points at it, (b) no sign-up credit although the Capped Variable 12 agreement enrolled 2023-10-16 is still on that plan with 35 completed cycles, (c) no loyalty credit for the 2025-11-04 renewal although the 2024-11-04 renewal carries one and 11 cycles of the 2025 term are billed. Each is resolved by its own policy's write with its own multi-factor amount, and all three feed the renewal's net supply cost per therm.

[Problem-tree card] Edges (form state, kind value_input, gate ref_cost):
 - renewal -> rebill: 'The renewal acceptance rate is fixed only after the energy line of the most recent bill, when it was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle, carries its rebill credit.' Opening evidence: gas_billing.d6eebd8a-2d5a-4092-b017-0406c683faee rate 0.8450, amount 26.20; the only rebill credit's source is the February 2026 line. Skip: 0.7897 vs 0.7786.
 - renewal -> sign-up: 'The renewal acceptance rate is not fixed until the agreement carries the sign-up credit that its completed billing cycles earned under its plan.' Skip: 0.8089 vs 0.7786.
 - renewal -> loyalty: 'The renewal acceptance rate is not worked out before every renewal that has taken effect on the agreement carries its renewal loyalty credit.' Skip: 0.81065 -> 0.8107 (half up) vs 0.7786.
 Four-point test per sentence: ordering connective, record-visible credit line, no code token, exact scope; exactly one policy writes each line type. The three commute (distinct line types; the rebill counts rebill lines, the loyalty credit counts loyalty lines for earlier renewals, none adds such a line for another). Renewal last. Persona names none; tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] gas_adjustment: gas_dispute_lookback (posted 2026-10-07, ends 2027-10-07 inclusive), gas_one_correction_per_line. gas_credit: one_gas_signup_credit, gas_credit_while_supplied (active), gas_renewal policy scope. gas_renew: renewal_active, gas_post_expiry_grace (not rolled over). Rebill scope (round 2): the line's cycle starts after the 2025-11-04 plan change, the latest variable notice was timely and effective before the cycle start, no regulatory pass-through notice exists, the plan is not month-to-month, so the allowed rate equals the base billing rate (no undeclared override).

[Business-object card] Agreement 353e5149-86b5-4830-a76b-3d881cb500b5. Rebill object: latest energy line d6eebd8a-2d5a-4092-b017-0406c683faee; excluded: the February 2026 line already corrected. Net supply cost window: lines with billing_period_start after 2025-10-16: 11 energy lines 781.33, prior rebill -29.06, new rebill -20.68, sign-up -56.25 (bill of 2026-10-04), loyalty -59.50 (bill of 2025-11-04) = 615.84; therms 926. Excluded: the 2025-10-04 cycle, every earlier line and the 2024-11-04 loyalty credit (bill of 2024-11-04).

[Factor cards] rebill: allowed_rate_basis (method; capped -> min(0.6620, 0.8450); baseline contract -> 0.00), billing_error_supplement (5.68 -> 5.00; -> 15.68), carried_charge_supplement (9 days -> 5.00; -> 15.68), repeat_error_supplement (one prior rebill -> 5.00; -> 15.68); gold 20.68; all-baseline 0.00. sign-up: online_enrollment (method; web, 19 days -> x1.25; -> 50.00), late_posting (1,077 days -> 10; -> 46.25), retention (346 days, term 12 -> 5; -> 51.25), lifetime_usage (2,825 therms -> 10; -> 46.25); gold 56.25; all-baseline 25.00. loyalty: loyalty_tenure (parameter multiplier; 731 days -> 1.5; fall-through 1 is a first renewal; -> 52.00), loyalty_late_posting (method: per-month accrual vs flat vs none; 11 months -> 22.00; -> 37.50), repeat_renewal (one earlier loyalty credit -> 5.00; -> 54.50), home_protection (cross protect at the premise; Gas Line Guard -> 5.00; -> 54.50), loyalty_winter_peak (199 therms -> 5.00; -> 54.50); gold 59.50; all-baseline 15.00. renewal: offer_choice (-> 0.7836), long_relationship (cross power; -> 0.7886), early_acceptance (-> 0.7811), heating_household (-> 0.7846), renewal_cushion (-> 0.8920), cushion_share (-> 0.8920); gold 0.7786; all-baseline 0.9390. Stamps: premises.annual_therm_usage = 874 is the utility's stale figure from enrollment; read in place of the ledger it gives the 0.0060 heating tier and a different rate; no rule reads it.

[Persona design] Rebecca Ingram, rushed physical therapist; volunteers only the renewal wish; identity on request; asks to correct the bill only if the agent raises it; accepts credits without asking amounts; runs the renewal with the agent's values; ends on confirmation.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify -> find_premises -> find_gas_agreements -> find_gas_billing -> find_gas_notices -> find_power_agreements -> find_protect_plans -> rebill 20.68 on d6eebd8a-2d5a-4092-b017-0406c683faee -> sign-up 56.25 (bill of 2026-10-04) -> loyalty 59.50 (bill of 2025-11-04) -> hand over renewal (Price Lock 12, 12, 0.7786, 2026-11-04, 2027-11-03).

[Verification run, round 2] Real tool replay + check_compute evaluator: rebill 20.68 (baseline 0; 0/15.68/15.68/15.68); sign-up 56.25 (25.00; 50.00/46.25/51.25/46.25); loyalty 59.50 (15.00; 52.00/37.50/54.50/54.50/54.50); renewal 0.7786 (0.9390; 0.7836/0.7886/0.7811/0.8920/0.8920/0.7846); skip rebill 0.7897, skip sign-up 0.8089, skip loyalty 0.8107; opening world 0.8522.

[Round 2 revisions] T1-F1/F-3: symptom loyalty_tenure mislabelled method with an unreachable fall-through, renewed_term unreachable; root cause thresholds at the structural minimum of a 12-month renewal; change: loyalty_tenure relabelled parameter with thresholds 1095/730 (fall-through = first renewal), renewed_term removed, late posting rebuilt as an honest method (per-month accrual vs flat vs none), new repeat_renewal factor; world given a first year (service start 2023-11-04, 12 energy lines, 12 variable notices, 2024 expiry notices, the 2024-11-04 renewal and its posted loyalty credit) so the customer sits on the mid tenure tier; re-run above. T1-F2: premises.annual_therm_usage changed 926 -> 874 (stale), no longer matching the ledger window. T1-F3 / O-1: compute rounding changed to exact half up (int(x*10^n+0.5)), proof figures recomputed (loyalty skip 0.8107). F-1/F-2: rebill rule scope narrowed so its allowed rate is the base rate (timely notice in force before the cycle start, same plan, no pass-through, not an introductory or held cycle); lines outside scope stay under base correction; gas_regulatory_passthrough added to lineage. O-2/O-3: net supply cost sentence now covers every line kind and states the zero-usage fallback. O-5: loyalty edge condition now covers every renewal. Gates re-run per task and difficulty-wide: all green except the deferred traceability gate.

[Easy mistakes] renewing at 0.9390 or before the credits; reading premise annual usage 874; taking the 2024 loyalty credit as the 2025 one; rounding 0.77855 down; counting the 2025-10-04 cycle.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rules, finder returns and persona alone the same three credits and renewal values follow; both 2026 notices name Price Lock 12.
user_scenario:
You are Rebecca Ingram, a physical therapist in the Pittsburgh suburbs, calling Beacon Ridge Energy on a short break between patients. You are direct and a little rushed. You got the emails saying your gas plan at home ends early next month, and you are calling because you want to accept the renewal offer and keep Beacon Ridge as your gas supplier for another year rather than drift onto a variable rate. You expect to confirm the renewal yourself if that is how it works; you are not interested in shopping other plans and you did not compare the two emails closely, so you go with whatever offer the agent says applies.

You give details only as they are asked for. To find your account you give your phone number, 4125550137. To prove who you are you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2864, and if they want one more thing, your ZIP code, 15228. Your home address is 318 Parkridge Lane in Pittsburgh. You do not know your rate per therm or what plan you are on beyond 'the one with a cap', and you say so.

If the agent tells you your most recent bill was charged more than your plan allows, you say then please correct the bill, and you let them do it. If the agent says a credit you should have received was never put on your account and they will add it, you say that is fine and thank them; you do not ask how much in advance and you do not argue about amounts. You never bring up your bills or credits yourself.

When the agent hands you the renewal to confirm yourself, you complete it exactly as they give it to you, with the plan, term, rate and dates they read out, and you tell them it went through. If a number they quote seems to change between one sentence and the next, you only ask them to check it against your account; you never suggest a figure. Once the agent confirms your renewal is recorded, you say thanks, mention you have a patient waiting, and end the call.

edges.condition: When the energy line with the latest billing period start was billed above the rate its plan allows for that cycle, a rebill credit whose source line is that energy line stands on the agreement.
edges.policy_source: The renewal acceptance rate is fixed only after the energy line of the most recent bill, when it was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle, carries its rebill credit.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The latest energy line (cycle 2026-09-04) was billed at the 0.8450 ceiling while the variable rate in force was 0.6620, and the only rebill credit on the agreement corrects the February 2026 line, not this one.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 posts a −20.68 rebill credit with source_billing_id = the 2026-09-04 line; without it the renewal acceptance rate would be 0.7897 instead of the gold path.

edges.condition: On an agreement still on its enrolled plan whose completed billing cycles reached the plan's sign-up qualification count while the plan pays a sign-up credit, a sign-up credit line stands on the agreement.
edges.policy_source: The renewal acceptance rate is not fixed until the agreement carries the sign-up credit that its completed billing cycles earned under its plan.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The agreement was enrolled on Capped Variable 12 (sign-up credit 25.00 after 3 completed cycles), is still on that plan, has completed 35 cycles, and carries no sign-up credit line.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 posts a −56.25 sign-up credit on the bill of the cycle starting 2026-10-04, inside the twelve-month window.

edges.condition: For every renewal that has taken effect on the agreement on a plan paying a loyalty credit, the latest one being the renewed term recorded by the plan change date, a renewal loyalty credit line stands on the agreement.
edges.policy_source: The renewal acceptance rate is not worked out before every renewal that has taken effect on the agreement carries its renewal loyalty credit.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Two renewals have taken effect (2024-11-04 and 2025-11-04, both into Capped Variable 12, loyalty credit 15.00); the 2024 one carries its −15.00 loyalty credit, but the 2025-11-04 one, whose renewed term has 11 billed cycles, carries none.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 posts a −59.50 renewal loyalty credit on the bill of the cycle starting 2025-11-04, inside the twelve-month window.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Fan-out of three parallel prerequisites. They write three different new bill lines and none of their computations reads what another writes: the rebill credit counts only rebill credits already standing (the sign-up and loyalty credits are other line types), the sign-up credit reads the agreement's dates, term and lifetime therms, and the loyalty credit reads the agreement's dates, the protection plan, the peak line and the loyalty credits standing for earlier renewals (none of the three writes adds such a line before it). Any order of the three therefore gives 20.68, 56.25 and 59.50 and the same three rows; the renewal acceptance, which reads all three through the net supply cost, comes last in every order.
